## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 35. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke asks the reader to pause twice — first to come to terms with Colorado State now being in the Pac-12, then to think about Mora, who got a second kick at the college coaching can at UConn and did extremely well with it. He gives the record: the football lifer was 27-23 in Storrs with back-to-back nine-win seasons, which he calls no small feat, and notes his first four seasons at UCLA were pretty good before the bottom fell out quickly. He records the one continuity decision — to provide some continuity, Mora kept interim HC Tyson Summers in his previous DC role — and then the programme's baseline: the Rams haven't won a bowl game since 2013 and have had a winning record just once since 2017. His conclusion is a hypothesis: perhaps Mora's previous stops are examples of what he can do at schools with lowered expectations, much like this one.
